from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

TARGET = Path("tests/infrastructure/test_universal_cross_asset_conformance_final_owner_r62n_guards.py")
text = TARGET.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

old_per_handler = '''                if node.finalbody:
                    final_environment = handler_environment.copy()
                    self._scan_block(node.finalbody, final_environment)
'''
assert text.count(old_per_handler) == 1
text = text.replace(old_per_handler, "", 1)

old_unhandled_final = '''        if node.finalbody:
            for raised_outcome in unhandled:
                final_environment = raised_outcome.state[0].copy()
                final_environment.pop(_R62N_EXCEPTION_TAG, None)
                self._scan_block(node.finalbody, final_environment)
'''
new_final = '''        if node.finalbody:
            if isinstance(node, ast.TryStar):
                pre_final_node: ast.Try | ast.TryStar = ast.TryStar(
                    body=node.body,
                    handlers=node.handlers,
                    orelse=node.orelse,
                    finalbody=[],
                )
            else:
                pre_final_node = ast.Try(
                    body=node.body,
                    handlers=node.handlers,
                    orelse=node.orelse,
                    finalbody=[],
                )
            pre_final = _r62n_process_try(
                pre_final_node,
                initial,
                top_index=0,
                timeline={},
                observations={},
                precision_lost=[False],
            )
            for pre_final_outcome in pre_final:
                final_environment = pre_final_outcome.state[0].copy()
                final_environment.pop(_R62N_EXCEPTION_TAG, None)
                self._scan_block(node.finalbody, final_environment)
'''
assert text.count(old_unhandled_final) == 1
text = text.replace(old_unhandled_final, new_final, 1)

old_name = "def test_r62n_trystar_cross_handler_state_is_sequential() -> None:"
assert text.count(old_name) == 1
text = text.replace(
    old_name,
    "def test_r62n_trystar_failed_star_cross_handler_remains_conservative() -> None:",
    1,
)
assert text.count('        assert "call:10" not in safe_markers\n') == 1
text = text.replace(
    '        assert "call:10" not in safe_markers\n',
    '        assert "call:10" in safe_markers\n',
    1,
)

anchor = "\ndef test_r62n_unknown_star_import_taints_new_call_names() -> None:\n"
assert anchor in text
extra = r'''

def test_r62n_trystar_static_group_cross_handler_state_is_sequential() -> None:
    safe = """\
b = eval
try:
    raise ExceptionGroup("eg", [AttributeError("a"), ValueError("v")])
except* AttributeError:
    b = len
except* ValueError:
    result = b("1+1")
"""
    dangerous = """\
b = len
try:
    raise ExceptionGroup("eg", [AttributeError("a"), ValueError("v")])
except* AttributeError:
    b = eval
except* ValueError:
    result = b("1+1")
"""
    assert _runtime_result(safe) == 3
    assert _runtime_result(dangerous) == 2
    assert "call:7" not in _r62n_dynamic_execution_markers_from_source(safe)
    assert "call:7" in _r62n_dynamic_execution_markers_from_source(dangerous)


def test_r62n_trystar_finalbody_observes_completed_handler_chain() -> None:
    safe = """\
b = eval
try:
    raise ExceptionGroup("eg", [AttributeError("a"), ValueError("v")])
except* AttributeError:
    b = eval
except* ValueError:
    b = len
finally:
    result = b("1+1")
"""
    dangerous = """\
b = len
try:
    raise ExceptionGroup("eg", [AttributeError("a"), ValueError("v")])
except* AttributeError:
    b = len
except* ValueError:
    b = eval
finally:
    result = b("1+1")
"""
    assert _runtime_result(safe) == 3
    assert _runtime_result(dangerous) == 2
    assert "call:9" not in _r62n_dynamic_execution_markers_from_source(safe)
    assert "call:9" in _r62n_dynamic_execution_markers_from_source(dangerous)
'''
text = text.replace(anchor, extra + anchor, 1)
TARGET.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
